title: Study Comparing Neoadjuvant Versus Adjuvant Stereotactic Radiotherapy of Brain Metastases
official: Prospective, Randomized, Multicenter Study Comparing the Efficacy and Tolerance of Neoadjuvant Versus Adjuvant Stereotactic Radiotherapy in the Management of Brain Metastases
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the local control rate on the target lesion at 6, 12, and 24 months after treatment with neoadjuvant stereotactic radiotherapy (SRS NEO group) compared to standard care, adjuvant stereotactic radiotherapy (POST OP SRS group).
sponsor: GCS Ramsay Santé pour l'Enseignement et la Recherche
